premises.text: Traditional login methods are frustrating and insecure
premises.evidence_span: Whenever I wanted to log into anything, I had to look for the right token or find the right app in my phone.

premises.text: Slick Login provides a seamless and secure authentication experience
premises.evidence_span: Today, we are launching Slick Login Closed Beta, which provides uncompromising security and an unbelievable user experience.

premises.text: The technology uses ultrasonic frequencies to connect devices for authentication
premises.evidence_span: our unique patent-pending technology which connects the two devices using audio signals.

premises.text: SlickLogin can operate without requiring new hardware for users or data centers
premises.evidence_span: we do not require you to buy any new hardware, not for your users, because we support all endpoints and all mobile devices.

premises.text: The product can provide identity and access management features
premises.evidence_span: SlickLogin can also provide identity and access management like never before.

premises.text: The market for identity and access management products is large and growing
premises.evidence_span: Market research shows that enterprises spend over 12 billion annually on identity and access management products.

value.text: Users experience a secure and enjoyable login process
value.evidence_span: the strong security, the solid security that we provide, and the magnificent user experience.
